description: The codebook describes variables in the full Dutch traffic-accident database and provides counts for 2015–2025, including missing or not-applicable categories. It explicitly includes confidential variables that do not appear in the public BRON release. This is a metadata and completeness information source for interpreting crash-analysis inputs, not a new release of the underlying accidents or confidential values. The authors warn that AI helped generate the codebook and it may contain errors. Access to this deposit is restricted and no file format is exposed. A later pilot-network restriction is planned and is not treated as completed. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
